learning_outcomes.text: To familiarize themselves with the characteristics of the entrepreneur, their traits & typology.
To know how innovation leads to new product development and differentiation from the competition.
To know how geographic, social, cultural and economic proximity, as well as participating in social networks and in innovation systems helps the birth of innovations and new products.
To learn how to recognize entrepreneurial opportunities and design products according to the principles of sustainable development.
To learn how to design a firm and how to raise funding.
Show social responsibility following the principles of sustainable development
Presenting their business plan briefly and clearly to investors

syllabus_topics: Innovation and the characteristics of startup entrepreneurs
Geographic, social, cultural and economic proximity – innovations systems – science & technology parks – startup incubators & accelerators
Entrepreneurship, modern global challenges and sustainable development
The basics of a business plan

assessment_methods.method: Quality of written assignment (homework) relevant to the course’s syllabus
Oral presentation in the class of their written assignment

assessment_rules: Student performance is evaluated through class participation, a written assignment, an oral presentation of the assignment, and a final written examination. The final exam combines multiple-choice questions and topic development. Students may view their exam scripts and ask questions after grades are published.
